description: This file defines a Java interface 'JsonArrayBuilder' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.json'. The interface specifies a fluent API for constructing a JSON array, allowing adding, setting, removing, and retrieving JSON values of various types, including primitives, strings, and other JSON values. It also includes methods for building and returning the final 'JsonArray' object.

classes.name: JsonArrayBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for a JsonArray, providing methods to add, set, remove, and retrieve JSON values, as well as build the final JsonArray.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds at least one int value to the JSON array to be built, with optional additional values.

methods.name: addIntegers
methods.description: Adds all given Integer values to the array.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces the value at the specified position with a new int, long, double, boolean, String, or JsonValue.

methods.name: addLongs
methods.description: Adds one or more long values to the array.

methods.name: addDoubles
methods.description: Adds one or more double values to the array.

methods.name: addBooleans
methods.description: Adds boolean values to the array.

methods.name: addStrings
methods.description: Adds String values to the array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more JsonValues to the array.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds a collection of JsonValues to the array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonValue at a specified index, if present.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a value at a specified index or a specific JsonValue from the array.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a new JsonArray containing all added values.
